newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp shares tops turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp shares tops turnover.

text.p: Shares in Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd topped the turnover lists on Tuesday as investors reacted to News Corp's tie-up with EchoStar Communications Corp to offer a subscription TV service in the U.S.
At 3.55 p.m. (0455 GMT), News Corp shares were 38 cents at A$7.10 on turnover of 8.9 million shares.
News Corp preferred shares were 42 cents up at A$6.05 on a volume of 8.5 million shares.
News Corp said it would contribute satellites, cash and other assets of US$1 billion from its American Sky Broadcasting (AskyB) unit in return for a 50 percent take in EchoStar.
"It's a beautiful thing," one Sydney-based broker said.
He said in-house analysis had estimated the deal was worth about A$2.6 billion to News Corp or about 65 cents per News Corp share.
